content:
Health and Quality of Life Outcomes is an open-access peer-reviewed journal that focuses on the conceptual, methodological, and practical aspects of health and quality of life measurement, including patient-reported outcomes, health-related quality of life, well-being, and patient experience. 

The journal publishes original research articles, reviews, commentaries, and case studies on topics related to health outcomes, such as the development and validation of measurement tools, the evaluation of healthcare interventions, and the examination of disparities in health and quality of life outcomes across populations. 

Health and Quality of Life Outcomes aims to provide a platform for researchers, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and patients to share their work and insights on how to measure, improve, and optimize health and quality of life outcomes. 

The journal is indexed in major databases such as PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science, and is widely regarded as a valuable resource for advancing the field of health outcomes research.
